_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 NKOWA EGWUREGWU:
• Ị malite na {start_chips} chips
• Deck otu nke 52 kaadi (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Ị na-egwuri egwu megide diiler (ụlọ)
• Ola egwuregwu na-eso usoro Ultimate Texas Hold'em: ị na-ebute ANTE na BLIND bets, inata 2 hole kaadi, kpebie na optional PLAY bets gburugburu oge betting, mgbe ahụ kpesa community kaadi na kọmpara kaadị ị kacha mma 5-kaadị megide diiler. Ebumnuche gị bụ ịkwado ụgwọ gị (mgbe ị nwere kaadị kacha mma), ebe ị na-ebelata ụgwọ gị (mgbe ị nwere kaadị njọ)
• Egwuregwu ahụ gwụsịrị mgbe ị ruru 0 chips ma ọlị ma ọ bụ karịa na mmalite nke egwuregwu (LOSS) ma ọ bụ kọńsị 1000 egwuregwu na chips (WIN)

💰 USORO BETTING:
• ANTE: Bet dị mkpa ${ante} kwa egwuregwu
• BLIND: Bet dị mkpa ${ante} kwa egwuregwu
• PLAY: Bet a na-ahọrọ n'oge egwuregwu. N'ozuzu egwuregwu, ị nwere ike ịhọrọ NAANỊ nke ndịa: (${ante4} ị bụrụ na ị mere ya na PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ị bụrụ na ị mere ya na FLOP, ma ọ bụ ${ante} ị bụrụ na ị mere ya na RIVER. Ị nwere ike ịkpọpụ ikpe na ọbara, ịhapụ akụkụ ahụ, ma ị meghị bet.)

🎴 KAADỊ DEALING:
• Ị natara 2 face-up kaadi (kaadị hole gị)
• Diiler natara 2 face-down kaadi (ndị a na-echi gị)
• 5 community kaadi na-ebu na face-down mbụ
• Community kaadi na-egosi gburugburu site na egwuregwu fases

🏆 NKEMDỊ DIILER:
• Diiler kwesịrị ịnwe kaadị PAIR (2 kaadi nke otu ọkwa) ịkwalite, na-eji 2 kaadi na aka ha na 5 community kaadi.
• Nkemdị diiler na-emetụta mpebetọ betting, dị ka ị ga-ekwu mgbe e mesịrị.

🎮 EGWUREGWU FASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) ma ọ bụ [check]
  • [4x]: Wee ${ante4} PLAY bet, kpesa mbụ 3 community kaadi
  • [check]: Enweghị bet ọzọ, kpesa mbụ 3 community kaadi

📋 FLOP:
  • Ị bụrụ na ị tọọ bet 4x: Naanị [skip] dịnụ (auto-reveals ikpeazụ 2 community kaadi)
  • Ị bụrụ na ị tọọghị bet 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) ma ọ bụ [check]
  • [2x]: Wee ${ante2} PLAY bet, kpesa ikpeazụ 2 community kaadi
  • [check]: Enweghị bet ọzọ, kpesa ikpeazụ 2 community kaadi

📋 RIVER:
  • Ị bụrụ na ị tọọ bet 4x ma ọ bụ 2x: Naanị [skip] dịnụ (auto-proceeds gaa na ikpeazụ)
  • Ị bụrụ na ị tọọghị bet PLAY: [1x] (${ante}) ma ọ bụ [fold]
  • [1x]: Wee ${ante} PLAY bet, gaa na ikpeazụ
  • [fold]: Hapụ akụkụ ahụ, hapụ ANTE na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kaadị ziri ezi na ịkọwapụta
  • Kaadị 5 kacha mma site na 7 kaadi (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets na-akwụnye ụgwọ ya dị ka ụkpụrụ ụgwọ

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Diiler adịghị ịkwalite: PUSH (bet ebufnụ)
  • Diiler ịkwalite & ị merie: 1:1 ụgwọ (bet + ụgwọ)
  • Diiler ịkwalite & ị hapụ: Bet efu
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ebufnụ)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Enweghị mmetụta site na nkemdị diiler
  • Ị merie: Bet ebufnụ na ụgwọ ọzọ dabere na ọdịdị kaadị gị
  • Ị hapụ: Bet efu
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ebufnụ)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Enweghị ụgwọ ọzọ

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Enweghị mmetụta site na nkemdị diiler
  • Kọmpara ziri ezi: Kaadị ị kacha mma vs Diiler kacha mma
  • Ị merie: 1:1 ụgwọ (bet + ụgwọ)
  • Ị hapụ: Bet efu
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ebufnụ)

🎯 NKOWA KAADỊ POKER (Kacha mma gaa na njọ):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 nke otu suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kaadi ọzọ nke otu suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kaadi nke otu ọkwa
  4. Full House: 3 nke otu + 2 nke otu
  5. Flush: 5 kaadi nke otu suit
  6. Straight: 5 kaadi ọzọ
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kaadi nke otu ọkwa
  8. Two Pair: 2 jo nke ọdịdị ọdịdị
  9. One Pair: 2 kaadi nke otu ọkwa
  10. High Card: Kaadị kacha elu merie

⌨️  COMMANDS ACTION:
• [4x] ma ọ bụ [play bet 4x]: Wee ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] ma ọ bụ [play bet 2x]: Wee ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] ma ọ bụ [play bet 1x]: Wee ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] ma ọ bụ [c]: Kọwaa (enweghị bet ọzọ)
• [fold] ma ọ bụ [f]: Fold (hapụ akụkụ ahụ)
• [skip] ma ọ bụ [s]: Gaa na egwuregwu ọzọ (mgbe enweghị omume dị mkpa)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Kaadị malite kacha mma (jo, kaadị elu) na-akwado bets 4x
• Kọwaa nkemdị diiler - kaadị njọ nwere ike ịkụnye ịkwalite diiler
• BLIND bet nwere ike ịkwado ụgwọ dị elu na kaadị kacha mma (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Lelee ọnụ ọgụgụ chip gị! Ọ bụrụ na ọ ruru 0 ma ọlị ma ọ bụ karịa na mmalite nke egwuregwu, ị hapụ.

⚠️  NOTES IMPORTANT:
• ANTE na BLIND bets dị mkpa kwa egwuregwu
• PLAY bets dị na-ahọrọ na usoro
• Kpebie ịnyefe omume ziri ezi, na naanị omume otu oge.
